title: Updates and Amendments to the Civil Service Rules
summary: Personnel Management Office — Rule — The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is confirming the effective date of the direct final rule updating and amending obsolete and outdated provisions of the Civil Service Rules. OPM received no significant adverse comments and therefore confirms that the direct final rule became effective as scheduled.

title: Procedures for Settling Claims
summary: Personnel Management Office — Rule — The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) confirms that the direct final rule updating the procedures for submitting certain administrative claims to OPM became effective as scheduled.

title: FLSA Claims and Compliance
summary: Personnel Management Office — Rule — The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) confirms that the direct final rule updating provisions concerning Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) claims submissions to OPM became effective as scheduled.

title: Federal Employees' Retirement System; Present Value Conversion Factors for Spouses of Deceased Separated Employees
summary: Personnel Management Office — Rule — The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is confirming the effective date of its direct final rule revising the table of reduction factors for early commencing dates of survivor annuities paid to spouses of separated employees who die before the date on which they would be eligible for unreduced deferred annuities. OPM received no significant adverse comments during the comment period and confirms the rule was effective August 24, 2026.

title: Implementation of HAVANA Act of 2021
summary: Homeland Security Department — Rule — This rule provides implementation by the Department of Homeland Security ("the Department" or "DHS") of the HAVANA Act of 2021. The HAVANA Act provides authority for agency heads to provide payments to certain individuals who have incurred qualifying injuries to the brain. This rule covers current and former Department of Homeland Security employees and their dependents.
